name: Cable Lying Pullover
steps: Position a flat bench facing away from a high pulley with a rope attached.
Lie face up with your head toward the pulley, feet planted, and reach back to grip the rope ends.
Keep your elbows softly bent as you pull your arms forward in an arc above your chest.
Guide your arms back overhead under control until you feel a stretch through your lats.
tips: Maintain a small bend in your elbows and keep your lower ribs down.
Avoid arching your lower back off the bench as your arms reach behind your head.
